links.outcome: AI caries detection accuracy on local historical radiographs versus expert reference standard
links.effect: Sensitivity 73.1%, specificity 94.3%, PPV 64.7%, NPV 96.1%, accuracy 91.6%; detection patterns differed significantly from reference standard (p < 0.001).
links.quote: Diagnocat™ showed high specificity (94.3%, 95% CI: 92.4%–96.0%) and NPV (96.1%, 95% CI: 94.7%–97.3%), with an overall accuracy of 91.6% (95% CI: 89.7%–93.4%).

links.outcome: Independent validation of a commercial AI tool by a party other than developer
links.effect: Independent validation of Diagnocat on bitewing radiographs found moderate sensitivity (73.1%) and low PPV (64.7%), so performance claims were tempered.
links.quote: This study offers an independent validation of Diagnocat™ using bitewing radiographs.

screen.reason: The study conducts an independent retrospective validation of a commercial AI diagnostic tool (Diagnocat) on dental radiographs to evaluate its diagnostic accuracy compared to expert consensus, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
